rough: The stats figure does not own its screen as strongly as the blueprint wants: 1981 sits at about 135 px at 1440 and the right half of the field is empty by design. The sixth size the blueprint implies was refused.
The phone opener stacks its three cut-outs between the photograph and the statements, which reads busy and pushes the statements below the first screen on a phone.
Entrance motion on the utility pages is the Reveal rise at 700 ms with 70 ms stagger; the look is judged from overview sheets only.
The first screen photograph is cropped at the viewport's bottom edge rather than to two thirds of its height.
The products families collapse over 320 ms when filtered; the motion trace reports the final frame as a vanish. Watched at speed it is a collapse, not a cut.
The contact page has not had a look round after its final changes; the 390 Contact layout was checked by gate and geometry only.

findings_for_the_notes.text: A useChapterProgress call in the component that renders StoryChapter reads the finished state (the hook needs the chapter's context). Put the hook in a child rendered inside the chapter.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: Opener.tsx before the split: statements stayed at p=1 at scroll 0

findings_for_the_notes.text: Story-check focus-hidden counts links inside an inert panel and inside a visibility:hidden panel as focusable. A closed menu is rendered only while open (three states: closed, opening, open, closing).
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: story-check.run.js FAIL focus-hidden on the closed menu
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: menu state machine; display none when closed

findings_for_the_notes.text: A time-based CSS animation on a picture in a live chapter fails the determinism check at p=0 (nondeterministic). Scrub the rise with the chapter's progress instead.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: story-check nondeterministic opener at p=0 on first visit
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: photo rise as a GSAP tween over the first quarter of the hold

findings_for_the_notes.text: The taste probe's empty-middle reads a clipped moving marquee's off-screen pictures as a horizontal gap; its blank-gap rule does not count flat colour blocks or single letters as content. Both are probe limits, defended in the report.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: taste-gate page scope on Home and every page's footer

findings_for_the_notes.text: The gate's covered-text rule caught a phone-only overlap (a branch note over a city name) that the 1440 layout does not show. Check the gate's other widths when a grid places children by column.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: taste-gate page scope on Contact, screen at 390
findings_for_the_notes.workaround: stack the branch rows on a phone

findings_for_the_notes.text: Playwright MCP's run_code_unsafe cannot read files outside the repo or use require or dynamic import in its context, and echoes the whole snippet per call; the taste toolkit's Chrome client (taste/scripts/lib/cdp.mjs) runs craft-lint and the font audit from Node without pasting them.
findings_for_the_notes.reproduction: browser_run_code_unsafe with a wrapper that reads craft-lint.js
